env.description: Bearer token the Stella engine was started with. The same value the engine's own container reads under its prefix; without it the assistant reports the engine as unavailable.
Where the Stella engine (stella-serve) listens. The in-app agent's turns run there; every model call and tool call comes back to this process to answer (ADR-053). Loopback on the node.

Vercel AI Gateway token — the platform's default AI auth. @oxagen/ai routes image, embeddings and video through the gateway always, and text too unless OXAGEN_MODEL_PROVIDER opts that deployment out, so this is required wherever AI runs.

CLI-only BYOK fallback: when no AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY exists anywhere, the CLI runs anthropic/* models directly against the Anthropic API with this key (other vendors and embeddings stay unavailable). The gateway key always wins when both are set. Never read by deployed services — platform AI is gateway-only.
OpenRouter token for language models. Read only when OXAGEN_MODEL_PROVIDER=openrouter; every other deployment stays valid without it.
Balanced text tier ("Oxagen Balanced") — gateway model id for the balanced tier.
Fast text tier ("Oxagen Fast") — the gateway model id @oxagen/ai resolves for the fast tier. The ask-page default.
Precise text tier ("Oxagen Precise") — gateway model id for the precise tier.

Which provider serves language models: the gateway (default, and the metered path) or 'openrouter' for a deployment that cannot reach the gateway. Never an automatic fallback — an operator opts out explicitly, because a silent failover would move spend to another vendor's bill and skip metering. Image, video and embeddings stay on the gateway either way.
Base64 256-bit KEK that wraps OAuth token encryption keys. Required in preview+production (enforced by the auth startup guard); blank locally disables it. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.
Session/cookie signing secret (≥32 chars). Minted once per env and applied identically to api + app so sessions validate across both.
Space-separated origins allowed cross-origin access to the auth API.
Auth base URL (the app origin).

Canonical production origin the shared social-login OAuth app's callback is registered against (OAuth Proxy productionURL). Preview deployments relay social login through this origin. Defaults to the production app URL when unset.

Dedicated secret the OAuth Proxy uses to encrypt/decrypt the relay payload between production and preview deployments. MUST be set to the SAME value in production AND preview for preview social login to work (production alone only passes through). Kept separate from BETTER_AUTH_SECRET to limit blast radius. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

ADR-052 governed-action meter mode: 'shadow' records actions against the annual counter and raises no debit; anything else (the default) charges. Set to shadow only for a staged rollout — the platform bills nothing at all while it is on.
Optional pinned solved meter markup (≥1). Leave unset to derive from OXAGEN_TARGET_MARGIN + the code config.
Target blended gross margin in (0,1). Drives the usage-meter markup; keep in sync with Stripe via `pnpm billing:stripe-sync --apply`.
Usage volume discount: purchase amount (USD) at which the discount caps; above this it stays flat at the max. 3% per $50 up to $250 ⇒ 15% max.
Usage volume discount: dollar increment that earns one OXAGEN_USAGE_DISCOUNT_PERCENT step (e.g. 50 = a discount step every $50 purchased).
Usage volume discount: percent off per OXAGEN_USAGE_DISCOUNT_INCREMENT dollars of usage credits purchased (e.g. 3 = 3% per increment ⇒ 15% at the $250 ceiling).
Consecutive failures before a breaker opens for a wrapped dependency call (Neo4j / Stripe / ClickHouse). Optional — defaults to 5 in packages/config/src/env.ts.
Milliseconds an open breaker waits before allowing a trial (half-open) request. Optional — defaults to 30000 in packages/config/src/env.ts.
Consecutive successes required in the half-open state before a breaker closes. Optional — defaults to 1 in packages/config/src/env.ts.
Cross-tool opt-out convention (https://consoledonottrack.com): set to '1' to disable CLI usage telemetry. Checked before OXAGEN_TELEMETRY and the persisted telemetry.enabled config.

Set to '1' or 'true' to allow stdio-transport MCP servers to be SPAWNED as child processes from workspace file-mcp plugin configs (packages/agent file-mcp.ts). Spawning is OFF by default because a workspace-scoped config could otherwise execute arbitrary commands on the API host — enable only for a trusted local/CLI runtime, never on shared server deployments. HTTP MCP transports are unaffected and always processed.
API token used by the CLI to authenticate requests; falls back to the value stored in ~/.oxagen/config.json.
Base URL for the Oxagen REST API, consumed by the CLI. Falls back to the default production API URL when unset.
Base URL for the Oxagen web app, where `oxagen login` opens the browser authorize page. Falls back to the default production app URL when unset.
When set, the CLI prints extra diagnostics (e.g. context-engine memory open failures) to stderr.
Default org slug for CLI commands; falls back to the value stored in ~/.oxagen/config.json.
Set to '0' to disable CLI usage telemetry for this invocation (equivalent to `oxagen telemetry off`). DO_NOT_TRACK=1 also disables it and takes precedence.
Default workspace slug for CLI commands; falls back to the value stored in ~/.oxagen/config.json.
ClickHouse database name.
ClickHouse password (empty for local Docker).
ClickHouse HTTPS endpoint.
ClickHouse user.

The engram DuckDB file @oxagen/context-provider reads. Unset means an in-memory store, so every query answers with nothing — the right answer for a misconfigured process, rather than someone else's memory. DuckDB opens a file as a single writer, so the process that writes this database and the process that serves it must be different.

The organisation whose memory @oxagen/context-provider serves. Required, with no default: the Context Graph Protocol carries no tenant, so one process serves one workspace and which one is a deployment decision. A process started without it refuses rather than guessing.
The workspace whose memory @oxagen/context-provider serves. Required, with no default, for the reason OXAGEN_CONTEXT_ORG is.
Default sender address. Its domain must be verified at the provider.
Default sender display name.
SMTP server host (Resend: smtp.resend.com).
SMTP password — for Resend this is an API key (re_…).
SMTP port. 465 = implicit TLS; 587 = STARTTLS (TLS enforced).
SMTP username (Resend: the literal "resend").
Local port for the env-manager web UI.
Vercel team id (defaults to the oxagen team).
Vercel team slug for `pnpm env:pull` --scope (e.g. "oxagen"). Optional — when unset, the CLI resolves the team from each project's linked .vercel/project.json.
Vercel API token (admin) the env-manager uses to read/write project env vars.

When set, high-severity/unhandled server errors are POSTed as a Slack-compatible `{ text, blocks }` JSON payload here (Slack/Mattermost/Discord incoming webhook, or any compatible endpoint). BYO webhook — no vendor SDK. When unset, errors are still recorded to the ClickHouse error_events table; only the webhook alert is skipped.
Vercel Blob read/write token. Authenticates @oxagen/storage (avatar/image uploads). Swap-point for S3/R2.
Selects the @oxagen/storage backend: 'vercel-blob' (default, prod) or 'fs' (local/CI filesystem driver, no token needed). The swap-point for an S3/R2 driver.
Root directory for the 'fs' storage driver. Only read when STORAGE_DRIVER=fs. Absolute path used as-is; a relative path is anchored at process.cwd(); unset falls back to an OS-tmp directory.
GitHub App OAuth client id — used for the data-connector OAuth flow.
GitHub App OAuth client secret.
GitHub App numeric ID. Required (with GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY) for the installation-token path in resolveGitHubToken(). Find it on the GitHub App settings page.
HMAC secret used to sign the OAuth state parameter for GitHub App installs.
PEM-encoded RSA private key for the GitHub App. Required (with GITHUB_APP_ID) for the installation-token path in resolveGitHubToken(). Generate in the GitHub App settings → Private keys.

GitHub App public slug (the path segment in https://github.com/apps/<slug>). Used to deep-link users to GitHub's install/configure page so they can add or remove orgs and repos. Optional — when unset the connection dialog derives the slug from an existing installation.
GitHub App webhook signing secret — validates inbound webhook payloads.

Personal access token (PAT) used by GitHub write capabilities (repo.create, repo.file.put, repo.fork, repo.branch.create, repo.pr.open) as a LOCAL/DEMO-ONLY fallback. Per-workspace credential resolution is now live (GitHub App installation token + KMS-encrypted per-workspace OAuth — see resolveGitHubToken in packages/handlers/src/lib/github-token.ts), so this MUST NOT be set in production: a shared PAT bypasses per-workspace scoping. resolveGitHubToken logs a loud warning when it is used while NODE_ENV=production.

Webhook signing secret for the SECOND GitHub App (oxagen-sh, app id 4055615), which delivers to the same /webhooks/github/app endpoint as oxagen-code-agent. Optional: unset means that App's deliveries are rejected.
Aurora writer endpoint for run-db-migrations.sh. Set it to skip the AWS lookup the script otherwise does.
Port for AURORA_ENDPOINT. Defaults to 5432.
Name tag of the data-plane EC2 instance the DB-client tunnel scripts target. Defaults to oxagen-data.
EventBridge bus the log-event-publisher Lambda puts events on. The stack sets it on the function; the handler refuses to import without it.
Name tag of the EC2 instance the infra/tools scripts target. Defaults to oxagen-app.
AWS KMS key ARN for credential encryption (INGESTION_CRYPTO_PROVIDER=kms).
Credential encryption backend for ingestion: 'env' (AES-256-GCM via INGESTION_ENCRYPTION_KEY) or 'kms' (AWS KMS).
Base64-encoded 32-byte master key for AES-256-GCM credential encryption (INGESTION_CRYPTO_PROVIDER=env).
Microsoft DATA OAuth client id for token refresh (ingestion cron; MS Graph offline_access).
Microsoft DATA OAuth client secret for token refresh (ingestion cron).
Salesforce DATA OAuth client id for token refresh (ingestion cron).
Salesforce DATA OAuth client secret for token refresh (ingestion cron).
Slack DATA OAuth client id for token refresh (ingestion cron). Token rotation must be enabled in the Slack app.
Slack DATA OAuth client secret for token refresh (ingestion cron).
Zoom DATA OAuth client id for token refresh (ingestion cron). Zoom rotates the refresh token on each use.
Zoom DATA OAuth client secret for token refresh (ingestion cron).
Inngest event key. Required in preview+production.
Inngest signing key. Required in preview+production.

HMAC secret this deployment signs Stella enterprise-telemetry enrollments with (create_stella_enrollment). A managed Stella install verifies the signature against its own copy of the same secret, named by the enrollment document's verification_secret_env — the two are distributed out of band. Unset means the capability refuses to mint rather than issuing an enrollment no install could verify.

Comma-separated HTTPS ingest endpoints this deployment serves for Stella operational telemetry. create_stella_enrollment refuses to sign an enrollment pointing anywhere else, so an operator cannot mint a valid document aiming a fleet of installs at a third party. Defaults to the public endpoint; plaintext entries are dropped.

Ed25519 private key (PKCS#8 PEM, newlines as \n) this deployment signs Tacho policy bundles with (get_tacho_bundle). The matching public key travels to each host at enrollment so tacho-hook verifies a cached bundle offline and fails closed on one it cannot verify. Unset means enrollment and bundle capabilities refuse.

HMAC secret this deployment signs Tacho host enrollments with (create_tacho_enrollment). The collector on an enrolled host verifies the enrollment document against its own copy of the same secret, named by the document's verification_secret_env; the two are distributed out of band. Unset means the capability refuses to enrol a host.

Comma-separated HTTPS base URLs of this deployment's Tacho machine endpoints (the /v1/tacho prefix). create_tacho_enrollment refuses to sign an enrollment pointing anywhere else, so an operator cannot aim a fleet of hosts at a third party. Defaults to the public endpoint; plaintext entries are dropped.
Linear API key (tooling/provenance; not read by deployed apps).
Linear project id for the oxagen-v2 project (tooling-only).

Per-request timeout (ms) for the app MCP OAuth authorize/callback flows when the MCP SDK fetches a third-party authorization server well-known / token endpoints. Bounds a hung server so it cannot stall the serverless function. Optional — defaults to 10000 in lib/mcp-oauth/safe-fetch.ts.
Neo4j database.
Neo4j password.
Neo4j bolt(+s) URI.
Neo4j user.
Runtime mode. Vercel/Next set this automatically per deploy.
GitHub LOGIN OAuth client id (social sign-in; minimal scopes).
GitHub LOGIN OAuth client secret.
Google DATA OAuth client id (Workspace data scopes; future connection).
Google DATA OAuth client secret.
Google LOGIN OAuth client id (social sign-in; minimal scopes).
Google LOGIN OAuth client secret.

Pre-registered OAuth clients for MCP authorization servers that do NOT support RFC 7591 dynamic client registration (GitHub MCP, notably). JSON object mapping the MCP server's endpoint HOST to the client registered with that provider, e.g. {"api.githubcopilot.com":{"client_id":"…","client_secret":"…"}}. Each provider app must list <app-origin>/api/v1/mcp/oauth/callback as its callback URL. When a host is absent the flow falls back to dynamic client registration as before.
Feature flag — set "false" to disable the Neo4j knowledge-graph writes.
Pino log level for service loggers.
HTTP port for the xmcp server.
OTLP HTTP collector URL (e.g. https://otel.example.com/v1/traces). When unset the SDK does not start and all spans are no-ops — safe for all envs. Rollback = leave unset.

Standard OTEL comma-separated `key=value` header list sent to the collector (e.g. "authorization=Bearer xxx,x-tenant=oxagen"). Optional — for collectors that require auth headers. Parsed by packages/telemetry/src/tracer.ts.
Service name tag on OTEL span resources (default: oxagen). Optional — leave unset to use the default.

Superuser Postgres connection used by provision-rls-role.ts to create the least-privilege app role. Kept separate from DATABASE_URL so the provisioning step cannot silently run through the restricted connection it is about to create.
Set to 1 to include draft posts when building the static research blog (apps/web/scripts/build.mjs). Unset in every deploy, so drafts never ship.
Path to a local context-graph-protocol checkout. check-contextgraph-fixtures.ts verifies the vendored profile against it when set.
Comma-separated stores `pnpm db:migrate` should migrate. Defaults to clickhouse,neo4j — Postgres is Atlas's job and is deliberately not in the list.
Google Cloud project the env-manager pulls Secret Manager secrets from. Defaults to oxagen-490023.
Set to 1 to point the Inngest SDK at a local dev server instead of Inngest Cloud. tools/scripts/inngest-dev.ts sets it for every child turbo spawns.
How many recent commits on main check-main-verified.mjs asks about. Defaults to 10.
npm automation token used to publish the CLI package. Unset skips the npm publish step of `pnpm release` rather than failing it.
Path to the oxagen-house-brand checkout sync-brand-assets.mjs copies marks from. Defaults to a sibling directory of this repository.
Base URL the published install.sh downloads CLI release archives from. Set it to install from a staging bucket instead of cli.oxagen.sh.
Directory install.sh puts the oxagen binary in. Defaults to ~/.local/bin.
Password for PGSUPERUSER.
Superuser on the cluster tools/scripts/rds-sim-check.sh simulates RDS against. The script refuses to run without it.
Password for PRODUCTION_ANALYTICS_USER.
Production ClickHouse endpoint tools/scripts/backfill-claude-telemetry.ts writes backfilled session rows to.
Username for PRODUCTION_ANALYTICS_URL.

Migration connection for tools/scripts/vercel-migrate.sh, holding a role that may run DDL against pre-existing schemas. The app role may only CREATE in schemas it owns, so migrating through DATABASE_URL fails 42501 on billing and friends.
GitHub owner whose repos the SCR corpus check reads. Defaults to macanderson.

Set to 1 to build apps/app or apps/docs with Next's standalone output. tools/scripts/package-for-node.sh sets it for the self-hosted node bundle; Vercel builds leave it unset and get the default output.
Email stamped on rows the Claude telemetry backfill writes, so a backfilled session is attributable to whoever ran the script.
Ref the vision gate diffs against. Defaults to origin/main.
Model the vision gate judges a diff with.
Set to 1 to make a drifts verdict fail the vision gate instead of only printing it.
Port for the apps/web static dev server (apps/web/scripts/dev.mjs). Defaults to 5500; local convenience only, never read by a deploy.
Container image the packaged node bundle's run manifest names. Defaults to node:22-alpine.
Neon Postgres connection string. Prod = live branch; preview/dev = dev branch.
Grace period in days before a hard-delete erasure job runs (GDPR Art.17). Set to 0 for immediate erasure in test envs.
Server-side app origin used to build plugin OAuth authorize/callback URLs (falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Not browser-exposed.
Public marketing website origin (oxagen.sh). The /v1/cms/* lead routes use it to build the emailed reader link and CORS allows it as a cross-origin caller. Not browser-exposed.
MCP server origin used to build install instructions and client connections.
Public api origin (browser-exposed).
Public app origin (browser-exposed).

chat_ux_v2 feature flag (apps/app chat UX overhaul, browser-exposed). "1" enables the new session-settings chat surface environment-wide; unset/anything else = off. A per-browser cookie override (?chat_ux_v2=1|0) wins over this default. Validated as an optional "0"|"1" enum by baseEnvSchema.

Optional override for the docs site origin (browser-exposed). When unset, apps/app resolves the correct URL per environment automatically (dev → http://localhost:3300; prod → https://docs.oxagen.sh, per apps/app/src/lib/docs-url.ts). Set only to test a custom docs deployment. Validated as an optional URL by baseEnvSchema.
Max chat send/stream requests per minute per workspace (fallback: per org, then per IP) on /v1/**/chat/*. Optional — defaults to 60 in packages/config/src/env.ts.

How many proxies sit in front of apps/api and append to x-forwarded-for. The client IP the IAM ip_ranges allowlist checks is the Nth entry from the right; entries left of it are caller-supplied. Optional — defaults to 1 (one ALB) in packages/config/src/env.ts. 0 disables the header entirely.

Platform version string surfaced by @oxagen/config platformVersion(). Written by `pnpm release:*` and synced to every oxagen-v2-* Vercel project. Declared in turbo.json globalEnv so a version change busts the build cache. LOCAL: leave unset → falls back to package.json version. PROD/PREVIEW: the released semver. NOTE: read via raw process.env in @oxagen/config — not yet in baseEnvSchema (tracked).

HMAC-SHA256 secret for signing audit-log export tokens, so exported files can be verified as untampered. OPTIONAL: baseEnvSchema declares it `.optional()` and the audit export route falls back to BETTER_AUTH_SECRET when it is unset. Setting a dedicated value changes the signing key and invalidates outstanding export download URLs. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

Extra hosts allowed to POST a Next server action to apps/app, comma-separated. Next rejects a server action whose Origin is not the deployment's own host, so a custom domain in front of the app has to be named here or every mutation 403s.

When true, Postgres RLS policies filter by org/workspace. Fail-closed: when UNSET it defaults ON in production (NODE_ENV/VERCEL_ENV=production) and OFF in dev/test/preview. A production process refuses to boot if this is forced to false (assertRlsEnforcedInProduction). Local dev override: set false in .env.local only if seeding/migration scripts need to bypass RLS; revert before running app code against the DB.
Browser-exposed Stripe publishable key for Stripe.js init. Inlined into the app bundle at build, so a rotation needs a rebuild. Sandbox pk_test_ in every environment until the production cutover.

Stripe publishable key. Every environment, production included, is the sandbox's pk_test_ key until the production cutover. Provisioning-only: no service reads it. The browser reads the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixed name, and env-manager pulls this one from the secret store so the two stay in step.
Stripe secret key. Every environment, production included, binds to the shared Stripe sandbox (sk_test_) until the maintainer cuts production over to live keys; see docs/ops/stripe-sandbox-mode.md.
When 'true', enables Stripe Tax automatic_tax on all checkout sessions. Ships dark; flip on only after Stripe Tax is registered/active in the dashboard.

Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_) of the endpoint registered on the shared sandbox for this environment's API URL; production's is the sandbox endpoint for https://api.oxagen.sh/webhooks/stripe until the cutover.

Set "true" in the vitest test lanes (declared in turbo.json test:unit/test:coverage env) so app code can branch to test-only behavior. Not for dev/preview/prod. NOTE: read via raw process.env — not in baseEnvSchema (test-only).

Set to "1" by tools/scripts/dev.ts for the local dev stack. Consumed by packages/auth to make local-env detection deterministic instead of racing NODE_ENV at module-load time. Ignored on real Vercel deployments (VERCEL=1 guards it). NOTE: read via raw process.env — not in baseEnvSchema (dev-tooling only).

Base URL Playwright drives in apps/app e2e (apps/app/playwright.config.ts). LOCAL: unset → defaults to http://localhost:3000. CI: the booted next server URL. NOTE: read via raw process.env — not in baseEnvSchema (test-only).

stores.purpose: Transactional state — users, orgs, permissions, billing, configs, durable application state.
Append-only runtime events — execution events, logs, metrics, traces, token analytics, telemetry.
Graph data — ontology/entity relationships, workflow lineage, agent memory, semantic retrieval.
Binary assets — avatars, generated media, uploads; the Postgres row (URL + metadata) is source of truth.

meta.description: Public profile/logo images; the blob URL is stored on the owning entity's avatar_url column (no generated_assets row).
Generated + uploaded media (chat attachments, exports, agent output); content.generated_assets is the source-of-truth reference row.

packages.description: Oxagen governance CLI — spend, lineage, grounding, credentials, and audit (agentic coding lives in the stella CLI)
packages.name: @oxagen/cli
